title: Forced Taylor-Green vortices: start-up, inertial pressure, vorticity (analytic)
description:
Water in a 64 x 64 um box, periodic in x and y (64 x 64 cells), at rest at t = 0 and driven by the divergence-free body force f = 2 mu k^2 U0 (sin kx cos ky, -cos kx sin ky), k = 2 pi / L (transient laminar flow, time-dependent study, 5 viscous times, ~1600 lattice steps).
Analytic (exact Navier-Stokes solution: the inertia u.grad u of Taylor-Green vortices is a pure gradient, balanced by the pressure, so the amplitude obeys a linear ODE): u_x = a sin kx cos ky, u_y = -a cos kx sin ky, a(t) = U0 (1 - exp(-t / tau_v)), tau_v = 1 / (2 nu k^2) = 52 us; p = (rho a^2 / 4)(cos 2kx + cos 2ky) (zero mean, as the gauge pressure without a pressure face); vorticity = 2 a k sin kx sin ky. Re = U0 L / nu = 6.4.
Probes tab: probe_u (u_x near a velocity maximum) with the dashed a(t) curve; probe_p (pressure near a maximum) with the quasi-static rho a(t)^2 / 4 (...) curve (not compared: lattice sound waves ring weakly during the start-up).
Derived values tab: u_tau (u_x at t = tau_v), u_end (last sample) and p_end (pressure at the end) against the closed form; expected ~1e-3 for the velocities (lattice viscous error ~(k dx)^2), ~1 % for the pressure; tolerances 5e-3 (u) and 2 % (p).
Line profile tab (final state): uy_profile (u_y along y at x = dx/2), p_profile (pressure along x at y = dx/2) and vorticity_profile (along x at y = L/4 + dx/2, interior points only: the vorticity is one-sided at the window edges; central differences shrink it by sin(k dx) / (k dx) = 1 - 1.6e-3).

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of water in Pa s

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: period in x and y (64 cells)

parameters.name: U0
parameters.description: steady velocity amplitude in m/s (lattice Mach ~0.03)

parameters.name: F_amp
parameters.description: body force amplitude 2 mu k^2 U0 in N/m^3

parameters.name: tau_v
parameters.description: viscous time of the vortex mode in s (~52 us)

parameters.name: a_tau
parameters.description: amplitude at t = tau_v in m/s

parameters.name: x_u
parameters.description: probe_u x (cell centre next to the sin kx maximum)

parameters.name: y_u
parameters.description: probe_u y (cell centre next to the cos ky maximum)

parameters.name: x_p
parameters.description: probe_p x (cell centre next to the cos 2kx maximum)
